issues: Light grey frosted tiles on a light grey background: the greyscale state almost melted into the stage, so the "field is full" beat never registered
The four waves were indigo, amber, teal and coral across the whole hue wheel, so the end state read as a rainbow swatch card rather than a brand
The flip was an opacity crossfade between two layers; the wavefront just changed colour with no sense of lighting up, and the background never reacted
The final state was just a screen of colour bands with no title or landing; the last frame was not a poster
changes: Ember look (warm black with orange and gold): icons are unlit dark keycaps (warm black base, hairline edge, lit top lip, dim grey glyph), so greyscale reads as "not powered yet" on the dark stage
Waves become one analogous sunrise gradient (gold, amber, orange, coral red) in four bands; still four waves sweeping down from their own start rows, each later wave covering lower rows

Each flip now powers on: the new colour fills the keycap top-down via clip, with a 1.22x pop, a screen-blend white flash once full and a glow overshoot; as each row lights, the stage behind it picks up a band of the same colour
Rhythm reworked: 48f centre-out reveal, then the whole field dims 12% during the rest as an inhale, then four waves finish in ~30f (was 42f) before the light settles
Added a landing: a central radial scrim, a 30px 400+ INTEGRATIONS kicker and a two-line 132px headline "Every tool, / one switch." rising word by word; 4% slow push throughout, duration 150 to 170f
